command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary
account=$(awk -F: 'tolower($1) ~ /demonstration account/ {v=$2; sub(/^[[:space:]]+/,"",v); sub(/[[:space:]]+$/,"",v); print v}' "$base/access.txt")
password=[REDACTED] -F: 'tolower($1) ~ /demonstration password/ {v=$2; sub(/^[[:space:]]+/,"",v); sub(/[[:space:]]+$/,"",v); print v}' "$base/access.txt")
[ "$account" = reader ]
[ -n "$password" ]
install -d -m 0750 -o root -g apache /etc/httpd/auth
printf '%s\n' "$password" | htpasswd -i -cB /etc/httpd/auth/staff.htpasswd >/dev/null
unset password
chown root:apache /etc/httpd/auth/staff.htpasswd
chmod 0640 /etc/httpd/auth/staff.htpasswd
sed -i 's/^Listen 80$/Listen 8080/' /etc/httpd/conf/httpd.conf
cat > /etc/httpd/conf.d/web-authentication-boundary.conf <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
ServerName web-authentication-boundary

Alias "/public/" "/srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/public/"
<Directory "/srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/public">
    Options -Indexes
    AllowOverride None
    Require all granted
</Directory>

Alias "/staff/" "/srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff/"
<Directory "/srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff">
    Options -Indexes
    AllowOverride None
    AuthType Basic
    AuthName "Staff"
    AuthBasicProvider file
    AuthUserFile "/etc/httpd/auth/staff.htpasswd"
    Require user reader
</Directory>

<LocationMatch "(?i)/(access\.txt|staff\.htpasswd)$">
    Require all denied
</LocationMatch>
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0644 /etc/httpd/conf.d/web-authentication-boundary.conf
semanage port -a -t http_port_t -p tcp 8080
semanage fcontext -a -t httpd_sys_content_t '/srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/public(/.*)?'
semanage fcontext -a -t httpd_sys_content_t '/srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary/staff(/.*)?'
restorecon -RFv "$base/public" "$base/staff"
httpd -t
firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=8080/tcp
firewall-cmd --add-port=8080/tcp
systemctl enable --now httpd
printf 'configured account=%s\n' "$account"
stat -c '%A %U:%G %n' /etc/httpd/auth/staff.htpasswd
systemctl is-enabled httpd
systemctl is-active httpd
ss -ltnp | grep ':8080[[:space:]]'

command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/web-authentication-boundary
account=$(awk -F: 'tolower($1) ~ /demonstration account/ {v=$2; sub(/^[[:space:]]+/,"",v); sub(/[[:space:]]+$/,"",v); print v}' "$base/access.txt")
password=[REDACTED] -F: 'tolower($1) ~ /demonstration password/ {v=$2; sub(/^[[:space:]]+/,"",v); sub(/[[:space:]]+$/,"",v); print v}' "$base/access.txt")
work=$(mktemp -d)
probe="$base/public/.listing-probe"
cleanup() { rm -rf "$work"; rmdir "$probe" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
mkdir "$probe"
restorecon "$probe"
public_code=$(curl -sS -o "$work/public" -w '%{http_code}' "http://$NODE_IP:8080/public/")
staff_anon_code=$(curl -sS -o "$work/staff-anon" -w '%{http_code}' "http://$NODE_IP:8080/staff/")
staff_wrong_code=$(curl -sS -u reader:definitely-wrong -o "$work/staff-wrong" -w '%{http_code}' "http://$NODE_IP:8080/staff/")
staff_ok_code=$(curl -sS -u "$account:$password" -o "$work/staff-ok" -w '%{http_code}' "http://$NODE_IP:8080/staff/")
roster_ok_code=$(curl -sS -u "$account:$password" -o "$work/roster-ok" -w '%{http_code}' "http://$NODE_IP:8080/staff/roster.csv")
listing_code=$(curl -sS -o "$work/listing" -w '%{http_code}' "http://$NODE_IP:8080/public/.listing-probe/")
access_code=$(curl -sS -o "$work/access" -w '%{http_code}' "http://$NODE_IP:8080/access.txt")
public_access_code=$(curl -sS -o "$work/public-access" -w '%{http_code}' "http://$NODE_IP:8080/public/access.txt")
password_file_code=[REDACTED] -sS -o "$work/passfile" -w '%{http_code}' "http://$NODE_IP:8080/staff.htpasswd")
